    Classes in com.github.jpmsilva.jsystemd that implement StatusProvider
    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    class 
    BufferPoolStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides the memory used by the direct and mapped buffers, such as Buffers: 64.0 MiB/1.0 GiB direct (412); 2.0 GiB mapped (3).
    class 
    CgroupMemoryStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides the memory used by the control group of the process, out of its limit, such as Cgroup memory: 700.0 MiB/1.0 GiB, or without the limit when there is none, such as Cgroup memory: 700.0 MiB.
    class 
    ClassLoaderStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides information regarding loaded classes.
    class 
    CpuStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides the CPU usage, such as CPU: 12.5% process; 40.1% system; load 1.20: the share of the available processors the process used since the status was last read, or since this provider was created, the recent CPU usage of the whole system, and the system load average over the last minute.
    class 
    ExecutorStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides information regarding a thread pool: the busy threads out of the threads in the pool, and the tasks waiting for a thread, such as workers: 3/10 threads, 5 queued.
    class 
    FileDescriptorStatusProvider
    Provides information regarding the file descriptors of the process: as a StatusProvider, the open file descriptors out of the most the process can open, such as File descriptors: 812/65536, and as a HealthProvider, for the systemd watchdog, reporting the application as unhealthy when they are about to run out, if enabled.
    class 
    GarbageCollectionStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides the garbage collection pauses since the status was last read, or since this provider was created: how many there were, and the share of the time they took, such as GC: 12 pauses, 0.4% of time.
    class 
    HeapStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides the memory used by the heap, out of its committed size, such as Heap: 139.5 MiB/256.0 MiB.
    class 
    NonHeapStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides the memory used outside of the heap by the JVM, such as by the metaspace and the code cache, out of its committed size, such as Non-heap: 62.7 MiB/64.1 MiB.
    class 
    OldGenerationStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides the memory used by the old generation of the heap after the last garbage collection, out of its maximum size (or its committed size, when it has no maximum), such as Old gen after GC: 120.0 MiB/512.0 MiB.
    class 
    PhaseStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider whose status is set by the application, to report what it is doing, such as Reindexing 40% or Migrating the schema.
    class 
    ThreadStatusProvider
    Provides information regarding the live threads: as a StatusProvider, the number of threads by state, and the number of deadlocked threads, if any, for the systemd status, and as a HealthProvider, for the systemd watchdog, reporting the application as unhealthy under the health conditions it is configured with.

    Classes in com.github.jpmsilva.jsystemd.spring that implement StatusProvider
    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    class 
    ActuatorHealthStatusProvider
    Provides the application health based on Spring Boot Actuator health contributors: as a HealthProvider, for the systemd watchdog, and as a StatusProvider, for the systemd status.
    class 
    ApplicationContextStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides information regarding the bean creation progress of a bean factory.
    class 
    ApplicationRunStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides information regarding the Spring Boot application startup sequence state.
    class 
    AvailabilityStatusProvider
    Provides the availability of the application, as Spring Boot reports it with its AvailabilityChangeEvent: as a StatusProvider, whether it is live, and whether it is ready to accept traffic, such as Liveness: correct; readiness: accepting traffic, and as a HealthProvider, for the systemd watchdog, reporting the application as unhealthy while its liveness is broken, if enabled.
    class 
    HikariStatusProvider
    Provides information regarding the HikariCP connection pools of the application: as a StatusProvider, for each pool, named after its data source bean, the connections in use out of the most the pool opens, and the threads waiting for a connection, such as dataSource: 7/10 connections, 3 waiting, and as a HealthProvider, for the systemd watchdog, reporting the application as unhealthy while a pool is starved, if enabled.
    class 
    JettyStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides information regarding the embedded Jetty servers of the application.
    class 
    LiquibaseStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides the progress of the Liquibase database migrations run on startup, such as Liquibase: applying changeset 042-add-index (41 applied).
    class 
    NettyStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides information regarding the embedded Reactor Netty servers of the application.
    class 
    ShutdownStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides the stage the application is at while it shuts down, such as Shutdown: waiting for active requests, so that a slow shutdown can be told apart from a hung one with systemctl status.
    class 
    TaskExecutorStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides information regarding the thread pools of the task executors and schedulers of the application, such as the ones Spring Boot sets up for @Async and @Scheduled methods, each reported by an ExecutorStatusProvider named after its bean, such as applicationTaskExecutor: 2/8 threads, 5 queued, taskScheduler: 1/1 threads, 3 scheduled.
    class 
    TomcatStatusProvider
    Implementation of StatusProvider that provides information regarding the connectors of the embedded Tomcat servers of the application.
